messages:
jordan_support: Hey team — can we enable PostHog exports for support session repros for a few trial accounts? Need to pull session events + minimal metadata to investigate bugs. Is that ok from a privacy perspective? /cc @sam_security
mike_eng: Quick q — do we need session-replay? PostHog can store full session & snapshots. We can configure masks and PII redaction (see below). But exports (CSV/JSON) could include email/user_id unless we strip them.
sam_security: We need: (1) data flow diagram, (2) retention policy, (3) access list for exports, (4) business justification. PostHog is allowed but only after security review. Can you paste the planned fields?
jordan_support: Planned fields: event, timestamp, session_id, path, console_logs, user_agent, user_email (opt), user_id (internal). We can drop email/user_id in exports. Need session playback for UX bugs.
elaine_product: Note: this will be used for EU customers too. GDPR concerns if we export email. Prefer pseudonymous ids.
mike_eng: We can pseudonymize user_id on export with a hash: ```python
import hashlib
def anon(id):
    return hashlib.sha256(id.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
```
Also PostHog mask config example: ```json
{"mask_all_text": true, "mask_regex": ["email"]}
```
sam_security: That helps. Also require: (a) retention <=90 days, (b) exports logged to S3 with restricted role, (c) access via ticket with TTL, (d) approval recorded in vendor-access form. Please attach vendor security review link: https://redwood.infra.internal/vendor-review
jordan_support: Got it. For S3 write access — who grants? @mike_eng or infra? 
mike_eng: I'll put a pre-signed exporter that drops user_email and replaces user_id with anon hash, writes to our gated bucket (vendor-exports). Will require an IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/vendor-exports.
audit-bot: Ticket #2345 linked: /vendors/posthog/export-request — state: pending security review.
sam_security: OK — prelim approval if you implement masking + retention + request workflow. Final after doc + flow diagram. :thumbsup:
jordan_support: Thanks — will update ticket with flow diagram and the mask config. Will ping when ready.
elaine_product: Also, include a short note for customers in onboarding about what we export (no emails).
mike_eng: noted. I'll start the exporter PR and add the masking config.
jordan_support: Closing loop — will await PR + security signoff. :white_check_mark:
